title: A free plan with online pay on says 'Pay ₹0 now', then says online payment is broken
what: Plans may cost ₹0. When the gym takes payments online, the join form shows a 'Pay ₹0 now' choice. After sending, the server makes no payment for under ₹1, so the done screen says 'Online payment is not working right now. Pay ₹0 at the gym desk'. The person is told something is broken when there is nothing to pay.
expected: A plan with nothing to pay never offers online payment, and the done screen says there is nothing to pay.
how_often: every time someone picks a ₹0 plan at a gym with online pay on
fix_line: Treat a plan under ₹1 as pay-at-desk on the form and on the done screen

title: A price with paise shows a different amount on the gym's page than on the join form
what: Plan prices may carry paise (₹999.50). The gym's web page rounds to whole rupees and shows ₹1,000, while the join form and the payment show ₹999.50 for the same plan.
expected: The same plan shows the same price on the gym's page, the join form and the payment.
who: visitors to a gym's web page
how_often: only for a plan priced with paise (Crispy Curves has none)
fix_line: Use one rupee format that keeps paise on the gym's page too

title: The gym's page, its join form and the page editor each count the plans differently
what: The gym's web page lists personal-training plans and stops at 12 plans. The join form behind its Join button leaves personal-training plans out and goes up to 40. The page editor in the admin app counts every active plan. A visitor can see a plan on the page that the join form does not offer, and an owner with more than 12 plans is told more show than really do.
expected: The page, the join form and the editor's count agree, or the page says which plans can be joined online and the editor says when some are not shown.
how_often: gyms with personal-training plans or more than 12 plans (Crispy Curves has 5 plans, none personal training)
fix_line: Mark plans that cannot be joined online on the page, and make the editor count what the page shows

items.reason: no number on these pages is worked out from a gap between visits; totals and trial end days come from the same server rows as their parts
